name: Genesis Mission
description: The Genesis Mission is a Department of Energy-led initiative that combines AI, quantum and high-performance computing to stand up supercomputers and a national platform, doubling the country’s research-and-development productivity across 20 federal agencies with a combined commitment of more than $5 billion to tackle 33 national challenges. Its demonstrated platform provides federated access through a Model Access Gateway to frontier AI models, simulation agents, national lab datasets and high-performance computing for 342 institutions, supporting 278 team-based awards in areas such as intelligent chip design, critical mineral extraction and commercial fusion energy.
novelty: It represents a whole-of-government approach to advanced computing that unites agencies such as DOD, NASA and NSF with multi-billion-dollar investments, while introducing a centralized federal research infrastructure with a federated single sign-on entry point that eliminates procurement barriers for accessing frontier AI and high-performance computing. The mission explicitly targets agentic workflows and autonomous experimentation as core methods for accelerating defense, biological and space research.
stakeholders: Twenty federal agencies including DOE, DOD, NASA, NSF, HHS, Transportation and Interior, plus 342 participating institutional awardees ranging from national labs to private-sector businesses and university research teams using the 20 NSF-funded test beds.
agentic_rationale: The mission’s challenge set includes “accelerating the design of weapons components with agentic workflows,” “scaling biological discoveries via data and autonomous experimentation,” and “mining decades of space data with agentic AI,” while the platform offers access to “simulation agents” and “AI agent frameworks” that enable complex scientific workflows across participating institutions.
tech_details: The initiative leverages AI, quantum computing and high-performance computing through a national platform featuring a Model Access Gateway for frontier tokens and models, a federated single sign-on entry point, DOE-developed model context protocol tools, and open protocols for user-built tool integration. NSF is investing over $400 million to establish 20 test beds and $100 million to curate AI-ready datasets for the mission.

source_titles.https://fedscoop.com/doe-genesis-mission: NASA, DOD and others join Energy Department-led Genesis Mission
source_titles.https://fedscoop.com/energy-department-d: Energy Department demos Genesis Mission platform

name: GOV.UK app
description: The GOV.UK app is a mobile application launched in July 2025 to give UK citizens personalised, joined-up access to government services and content. It includes GOV.UK Chat, an AI-enabled tool that answers questions using only official GOV.UK guidance, plus an AI-powered search bar. The app has been downloaded over 600,000 times and is expanding to integrate data such as DVLA driver and vehicle information.
novelty: It offers a single, personalised mobile gateway to government that grounds AI responses exclusively in official content to ensure trustworthiness. The team is now exploring agentic AI to move beyond information retrieval toward helping users autonomously complete tasks and find the right support.
stakeholders: UK citizens accessing public services, the Government Digital Service (GDS), and government agencies such as the DVLA that are connecting data to the app.
agentic_rationale: The source reports that the team is exploring how agentic AI could support users to complete tasks and navigate to the correct support more easily, indicating planned autonomous guidance through task completion rather than purely human-initiated Q&A.
tech_details: The app features GOV.UK Chat, which generates AI-enabled answers drawn solely from official GOV.UK content, alongside a native AI-powered search bar. It is being integrated with DVLA systems to display driver and vehicle information directly in the app.

source_titles.https://gds.blog.gov.uk/2026/07/01/gov-u: GOV.UK app: One year of easier, faster services in your pocket

name: Draft Intelligence Service Reform Law (autonomous AI operational measures)
organisation: Federal Ministry of the Interior (BMI), Germany
description: The German Federal Ministry of the Interior published a draft law to fundamentally restructure the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) and the Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution (BfV). The bill expands intelligence powers to include hacking back during cyberattacks, automated data analysis, and biometric matching. Most controversially, it explicitly allows AI systems to autonomously trigger and execute operational measures such as hackbacks.
novelty: The draft law breaks new ground by explicitly permitting AI systems to autonomously initiate offensive cyber operations without human intermediation, arguing that a human processing step would delay defense without providing relevant quality assurance.
stakeholders: The initiative involves the Federal Ministry of the Interior, the BND, the BfV, civil society organizations such as the GFF and AG Kritis, the Federal Commissioner for Data Protection, and the general public subject to expanded surveillance.
agentic_rationale: The draft law provides that AI systems shall autonomously trigger operational measures, specifically automatically initiating and conducting hackbacks. The BMI explicitly justifies bypassing human review by stating: "Ein Zwischenschritt menschlicher Bearbeitung leistet hier keine relevante Qualitätssicherung, verzögert aber Abwehr erfolgsgefährdend."
tech_details: The draft refers to KI-Systeme for autonomous operational triggering, automated "qualified" evaluation of personal data, state trojans for online searches, and biometric matching using internet data and commercial facial recognition engines. No specific AI models or technical architectures are named.

name: Jeen Defense Sovereign Agentic AI Platform
organisation: Israeli Ministry of Defense and strategic security agencies
description: Jeen Defense provides a sovereign, fully offline agentic AI platform embedded across Israeli defense agencies for intelligence analysis, operational planning, and administrative workflows. The system operates without internet connectivity under strict security controls and has secured framework agreements valued at up to NIS 45 million, with NIS 8.6 million in orders already executed.
novelty: First sovereign agentic AI platform designed specifically for defense to operate entirely offline without reliance on global cloud providers like OpenAI, enabling secure generative AI deployment in sensitive intelligence and operational environments.
stakeholders: Israeli defense agencies, intelligence community (including former Mossad and Shin Bet officials), defense prime contractors, military commanders, and civilian institutions including Bank Mizrahi and Israel Electric Corporation.
agentic_rationale: The platform is explicitly described as an "agentic AI platform" that provides "cognitive support" to commanders "when they're exhausted" and autonomously executes "intelligence analysis, operational planning, and administrative workflows" without requiring human initiation of each step or cloud connectivity.
tech_details: Secure generative AI platform capable of running entirely offline under strict security controls, sovereign AI systems architecture designed to operate without internet connectivity, supporting both defense and dual-use civilian applications.

source_titles.https://www.jpost.com/defense-and-tech/a: Jeen Technologies deepens footprint in Israel's defense sector

name: NIST NCCoE Software and AI Agent Identity Project
organisation: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
description: NIST's National Cybersecurity Center of Excellence (NCCoE) published a draft concept paper examining how existing identity standards and practices apply to autonomous AI agents. The initiative aims to develop standards-based methods to identify agents, manage their permissions, authorize their actions, and connect those actions to an accountable person or organization as federal agencies confront agentic AI adoption.
novelty: It treats AI agents as a distinct identity category requiring dedicated governance frameworks rather than invisible extensions of human users, recognizing that autonomous software introduces new privileged identities that conventional service account models cannot secure.
stakeholders: Federal agencies, cybersecurity and identity teams, AI agent developers and operators, and standards bodies including CISA and international partners.
agentic_rationale: The source reports that an AI agent may independently choose among tools, retrieve records, generate content, deploy code, or initiate transactions, acting on behalf of users with limited human supervision.
tech_details: The project explores applying existing identity standards and zero trust principles to AI agents across cloud and on-premises environments, focusing on continuous lifecycle management including provisioning, behavior monitoring, and privilege review.

source_titles.https://www.meritalk.com/agentic-ai-rais: Agentic AI Raises the Stakes for Federal Identity Governance

name: Souveräne digitale Assistenz für Kommunen
description: The city of Rüsselsheim is piloting a sovereign AI assistance system for municipal administration, funded with €309,000 by the state of Hesse. It integrates three tools into a German-operated, open, data-sovereign platform: an AI protocol generator that automatically creates, structures and formally checks meeting minutes from notes or audio files; a semantic search and dialogue component accessing a local knowledge database to retrieve information from documents and archives; and an email assistant that automatically classifies, prioritizes and semi-automates responses while summarizing email threads. The project aims to develop a reusable reference architecture for other municipalities.
novelty: It combines three distinct AI assistants (protocol generation, semantic knowledge search and email triage) into a sovereign, locally operated platform specifically designed to serve as a transferable template for other German municipalities, emphasizing data sovereignty and practical applicability.
stakeholders: Municipal employees of Rüsselsheim city administration who use the tools to reduce routine workload; citizens who benefit from improved administrative service; and other Hessian municipalities intended to adopt the reference architecture.
agentic_rationale: The email assistant automatically classifies and prioritizes incoming emails as well as drafts responses without requiring human initiation for each item ("automatisch zu klassifizieren, zu priorisieren und teilautomatisiert zu beantworten"). The protocol tool autonomously generates, structures and formally checks meeting minutes from audio or notes ("automatisch erstellt, strukturiert und formal überprüft").
tech_details: Built on an existing German-operated, open, data-sovereign platform for the public sector with a local knowledge database. The three AI functions (protocol generation, semantic search/dialogue, email assistance) are integrated into this environment for practical testing.

name: IndiaAI Safe & Trusted AI pillar — Saakshya
organisation: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
description: The Safe & Trusted AI pillar under the IndiaAI Mission advances responsible AI through 13 approved research projects and the 'Saakshya' multi-agent deepfake-detection framework. It also established the IndiaAI Safety Institute and risk-based governance guidelines to promote secure, fair and trustworthy AI.
novelty: It introduces a dedicated multi-agent framework ('Saakshya') for deepfake detection and creates new indigenous oversight institutions, including the IndiaAI Safety Institute and a risk-based governance framework with bodies such as AIGEG and TPEC.
stakeholders: Indian citizens, domestic AI startups and research institutions (IITs, NITs, DIAT), state and union territory governments, industry partners, and international governance forums.
agentic_rationale: The source reports 'Saakshya', a 'multi-agent framework developed by IIT Jodhpur and IIT Madras for deepfake detection'.
tech_details: The pillar supports 20 sovereign indigenous LLM and SLM proposals and funds projects spanning federated learning, machine unlearning, bias mitigation and explainable AI; Saakshya specifically employs a multi-agent architecture for deepfake detection.

source_titles.https://ddindia.co.in/2026/07/indiaai-mi: IndiaAI Mission's Safe & Trusted AI pillar advances responsible AI, 13 projects approved to tackle deepfakes and bias

name: Note exploratoire sur l'IA agentique et les données personnelles
organisation: CNIL and CIANum (Conseil de l'IA et du Numérique)
description: CNIL and CIANum published an exploratory note analyzing the data protection challenges posed by agentic AI systems. These systems can act autonomously on behalf of users, process large volumes of personal data from multiple sources, maintain persistent interaction histories, and create hyperpersonalized profiles. The note highlights risks of user control loss over data and complexities in allocating responsibilities among actors under GDPR.
novelty: The note identifies a 'changment d'échelle' (change of scale) from generative to agentic AI, specifically examining how autonomous decision-making capabilities, persistent memory, and complex multi-service data flows create novel challenges for data protection frameworks that were designed for less autonomous systems.
stakeholders: CNIL, CIANum, users of agentic AI systems, AI developers and deployers, and international data protection authorities (G7 Privacy Authorities).
agentic_rationale: The systems feature 'capacités d'action autonome' enabling them to 'agir sur leur environnement à la place de leur utilisateur' and 'automatiser des processus décisionnels' involving multiple actors, operating with 'autonomie décisionnelle accrue' and persistent memory to act across multiple connected services without human initiation of each step.
tech_details: The note discusses agentic AI systems built upon generative AI foundations, featuring persistent memory ('mémoires persistantes') and connections to multiple external data sources and services, though no specific models or platforms are identified.

source_titles.https://cnil.fr/fr/ia-agentique-cnil-cia: IA agentique et données personnelles : la CNIL et le Conseil de l’IA et du Numérique publient une note exploratoire

name: Schleswig-Holstein Police Law surveillance expansion
description: The Schleswig-Holstein state government is advancing a police law that expands automated surveillance capabilities, including AI-powered video analysis that independently recognizes faces, evaluates behavior, and tracks individuals across camera networks. An amendment would additionally permit filming inside moving vehicles to automatically detect drivers using electronic devices, read license plates, and identify offenders, alongside authorizing armed anti-drone measures and lowering thresholds for covert recordings.
novelty: The law authorizes automated in-car video analysis to detect specific driver behaviors—such as holding electronic devices—and enables persistent cross-camera tracking and identification of individuals without prior suspicion, significantly expanding autonomous police surveillance powers.
stakeholders: Drivers and citizens in Schleswig-Holstein, state police forces, civil liberties advocates, and state parliamentary committees.
agentic_rationale: The video surveillance system independently recognizes faces, evaluates behavior, and tracks people across camera networks, while in-car video analysis software automatically detects whether drivers hold electronic devices and triggers automatic license plate reading and driver identification without a human initiating each individual check.
tech_details: Automated video analysis and facial recognition software, Palantir-style automated data analysis systems, license plate recognition, and armed drones equipped with nets for intercepting hostile drones.

source_titles.https://netzpolitik.org/2026/polizeigese: Polizeigesetz-Erweiterung in Schleswig-Holstein: Schwarz-Grün will dich beim Autofahren filmen

name: AI Document Automation (Dunkelverarbeitung) in German Public Administration
description: Analysis of transitioning from pilot projects to productive AI-supported document processing in German public administration. The approach uses confidence-based automation ('Dunkelverarbeitung') to handle high-volume document processing, combining specialized models for standard forms with language models for complex cases, while navigating legal constraints under § 35a VwVfG that restrict fully automated administrative acts without explicit legal basis.
novelty: Frames the digitization challenge as organizational rather than technical, proposing a risk-based confidence threshold approach calibrated on real production data. This allows automatic processing of routine cases while legally mandating human oversight for low-confidence or discretionary decisions, adapting private-sector automation models to public administrative law constraints.
stakeholders: German civil servants facing retirement-driven staff shortages, citizens and businesses applying for permits and services, regulatory auditors requiring traceability, and technology providers offering GDPR-compliant EU-hosted solutions.
agentic_rationale: Systems execute 'Dunkelverarbeitung' (dark processing) where document workflows run automatically without human initiation for each case: 'Oberhalb eines definierten Schwellenwerts läuft ein Vorgang automatisch durch'. The system autonomously decides whether to complete processing or escalate to human review based on confidence values, applying reproducible extraction and classification to standard document types at scale.
tech_details: Hybrid architecture combining stable, document-type-specific models for mass-volume reproducible processing with language models handling language understanding, classification and evaluation. Features confidence scoring with adjustable thresholds calibrated against production data, EU-based processing, GDPR compliance, and built-in auditability with full versioning and traceability.

source_titles.https://www.egovernment.de/digitale-souv: Digitale Souveränität heißt auch: handeln können

name: Six Networks
description: The Six Networks is a national infrastructure programme scheduled for completion by 2030 that integrates electricity, water, telecommunications, computing, logistics and underground pipe networks. Costing an estimated 26 trillion yuan (S$5 trillion), it aims to build advanced digital infrastructure—including supercomputing centres, AI compute hubs and 6G networks—while upgrading power grids and logistics to support China’s AI ambitions, manufacturing base and low-carbon transition.
novelty: It is the first time China has brought its largest infrastructure projects under a single integrated programme rather than developing transport, energy and communications networks separately, explicitly designing the physical backbone to support an AI-driven economy.
stakeholders: The Chinese government, state-owned policy banks, private investors, corporations, and manufacturing industries and citizens who will rely on the integrated power, data and logistics systems.
agentic_rationale: The plan includes developing an AI-powered dispatch system capable of monitoring the power grid in real time, adjusting power flows and matching renewable energy supply with data centre demand without human initiation of each step. It also envisions a nationally coordinated system that autonomously directs AI workloads to whichever data centres have spare capacity.
tech_details: The programme plans high-performance supercomputing centres, general-purpose data centres, AI-focused compute hubs, ultra-high-speed fibre broadband, satellite internet and 6G networks, alongside an AI-powered electricity grid dispatch system and unified workload routing across national data centres.

source_titles.https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-a: Six Networks: Inside China’s trillion-dollar bet to wire its economy for an AI era

name: Alberta Agentic AI Digital Modernization Pilot
description: Alberta is testing agentic AI to accelerate digital modernization efforts, compressing project timelines that typically take years into results achieved within one week. The initiative is featured in an Info-Tech Research Group podcast highlighting practical government technology applications.
novelty: Reducing multi-year digital modernization timelines to one week through the application of agentic AI systems.
stakeholders: Alberta government digital transformation teams, Info-Tech Research Group, and citizens benefiting from accelerated modernization of public services.
agentic_rationale: Testing agentic AI to autonomously execute or accelerate digital modernization efforts, achieving results in one week instead of years. The source does not specify concrete autonomous decision-making or coordination mechanisms beyond the acceleration claim.
tech_details: Not specified beyond agentic AI systems.

source_titles.https://x.com/infotechRG/status/20817867: Alberta Pilots Agentic AI for Rapid Government Modernization

name: IndiaAI Mission
organisation: Government of India (Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology)
description: The IndiaAI Mission is a comprehensive national AI initiative approved in March 2024 with an outlay of Rs 103.71 billion over five years to build a sovereign AI ecosystem across seven pillars including Safe and Trusted AI and Compute Capacity. It supports 20 indigenous model proposals (12 LLMs and 8 SLMs), has sanctioned 9.3 million GPU hours for 237 projects, and established 27 India Data and AI Labs alongside 58 AI Centres of Excellence, with concrete operational deployments including the AskDISHA virtual assistant for Indian Railways and BharatGPT for the Indian Army.
novelty: The mission explicitly targets development of indigenous 'agentic AI systems' as domain-specific SLMs and deploys Saakshya, a multi-agent framework developed by IIT Jodhpur and IIT Madras for deepfake detection, alongside sovereign LLM implementations enabling autonomous voice-based transactions in Indian languages including Hinglish.
stakeholders: Indian startups (Sarvam AI, Gnani.AI, BharatGen, Avataar AI, CoRover), educational institutions (IITs, NITs, DIAT), state/UT governments, Indian Railways passengers, Indian Army personnel, and citizens benefiting from responsible AI governance.
agentic_rationale: The mission reports development of 'domain-specific SLMs... addressing... agentic AI systems' including 'Saakshya, multi-agent framework... for deep fake detection'. Additionally, the AskDISHA system autonomously executes 'voice-based ticket booking' for Indian Railways through conversational interaction in Hindi, English and Hinglish, performing reservations without human initiation of each step.
tech_details: Indigenous sovereign models including Sarvam 30B/105B parameter LLMs, Gnani.AI speech-to-speech, BharatGen multilingual foundation models, Avataar AI video generation, and CoRover's BharatGPT platform supporting 12-plus languages via voice and 22 for text. Multi-agent frameworks including Saakshya for deepfake detection and federated learning architectures for privacy-preserving machine learning.

source_titles.https://tele.net.in/national-news/indias: India's safe and trusted AI pillar powers responsible innovation while shaping global AI governance, says IT minister

name: National AI Deployment Plan
description: President Putin instructed the Russian government to develop a national plan for AI deployment to accelerate integration across the economy, state administration, education, risk assessment, and defense sectors. The initiative emphasizes technological sovereignty through domestically produced AI solutions, framing advanced AI agent autonomy as essential for national security and economic transformation.
novelty: The strategy explicitly targets AI agent autonomy as a matter of national sovereignty and existential importance, with Putin highlighting that agents are learning to independently plan actions, evaluate results, and interact with humans and the real world.
stakeholders: Russian government agencies, defense and security sectors, educational institutions, economic ministries, and domestic technology developers.
agentic_rationale: Putin stated that 'AI agents are approaching a new level of independence. They are learning to plan actions, evaluate results and interact with humans and the real world,' describing concrete autonomous planning, evaluation, and interaction capabilities without human initiation of each step.
tech_details: Emphasis on domestically developed AI solutions, digital platforms, and automated systems produced independently by the government; specific models, architectures, or integration details not provided.

name: London autonomous passenger vehicle pilot permitting
description: Transport for London is considering pilot applications for autonomous passenger services under its automated passenger services permitting scheme. Industry body techUK has submitted evidence to the London Assembly Transport Committee supporting approval, noting that several operators are preparing to deploy driverless services in the capital this year pending regulatory sign-off.
novelty: The initiative aims to establish the UK as having the most comprehensive and secure autonomous vehicle framework globally, with a focus on safety data showing 82% fewer injury-causing crashes than human drivers and expanding door-to-door mobility for older and disabled Londoners who cannot drive.
stakeholders: techUK and its Self-Driving Vehicles Working Group (technology operators), Transport for London, the London Assembly Transport Committee, older and disabled Londoners, and fleet maintenance and AI development workforces.
agentic_rationale: The vehicles operate as 'driverless passenger services' that autonomously navigate London streets and transport passengers without a human driver present in the vehicle or initiating each driving action, capable of operating as part of a 'hybrid network alongside human drivers'.
tech_details: Operators have conducted safety testing under the Department for Transport's Code of Practice since 2017; specific AI models, sensor suites, or vehicle platforms are not named.

name: Memorandum of Understanding with Salesforce for Agentic AI Transformation
organisation: Government of Entre Ríos Province (Secretariat of Modernization, Science, Technology and Innovation)
description: The Province of Entre Ríos signed a preliminary memorandum with Salesforce to implement agentic AI for digital government transformation. The agreement includes free AI skills training for officials via Salesforce's online platform and contemplates future deployment of autonomous agents to streamline public procedures and improve citizen experience, though no data-processing systems are yet operational.
novelty: It represents the province's first formal step toward AI in government and was executed through direct gubernatorial signature without standard administrative decree or legislative oversight, bypassing normal procurement approval channels.
stakeholders: Citizens of Entre Ríos (intended service beneficiaries), provincial government officials and agencies (including IAPSER and Mirador TEC), and Salesforce, Inc.
agentic_rationale: The agreement explicitly targets 'transformación digital y agéntica' using AI agents defined as having the 'capacidad de actuar de manera autónoma, tomar decisiones y ejecutar planes por cuenta propia para lograr un objetivo' and being 'sistemas capaces de operar con poca ayuda humana', aligned with Salesforce's Agentforce autonomous agent platform.
tech_details: Salesforce Agentforce platform for autonomous agents and Salesforce's online training platform; cloud-based architecture contemplated for future implementation.

source_titles.https://www.elentrerios.com/actualidad/i: Inteligencia Artificial. El convenio entre el gobierno y la empresa Salesforce fue sin decreto y con un registro que llegó tarde

name: GovOrch AI
organisation: United States Department of Defense (Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office)
description: GovOrch AI is a governed agentic AI solution developed by REI Systems to connect disparate data sources within government agencies without requiring lengthy system replacements or wholesale data centralization. It achieved “Awardable” status through the DoD Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office’s Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace and is intended to reduce time spent on information searching, reconciling and routing across federal agencies.
novelty: It enables agencies to extract value from existing legacy data infrastructure by using agentic AI to autonomously connect and reconcile data, rather than requiring expensive and time-consuming system replacements or centralization projects first.
stakeholders: Federal agencies including the Department of Defense, FDA, NASA, and GSA as users and beneficiaries; REI Systems as the technology provider; and government employees who utilize the system to streamline data management tasks.
agentic_rationale: The system uses “governed, agentic AI” to autonomously “connect data where it already resides” and execute tasks of “searching for, reconciling and routing information” without requiring human initiation of each data retrieval or routing step, allowing staff to focus on judgment and oversight.
tech_details: Achieved “Awardable” status on the Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace operated by the DoD Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office; designed to interface with existing legacy systems without requiring replacement; specific underlying models or architecture not detailed.

source_titles.https://washingtonexec.com/2026/07/top-b: Top BD & GM Execs to Watch in 2026: REI Systems’ Wagish Bhartiya

name: JULIA
description: JULIA is a generative AI virtual assistant launched by Roma Capitale in March 2025 to improve citizen access to municipal services. Accessible via WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger and web chat in over 80 languages, it acts as an intelligent intermediary that identifies relevant services and guides users through procedures. Version 2.5 introduces a super-agent orchestrator that coordinates specialized agents and is integrated into the city’s institutional portal to answer questions using certified knowledge bases.
novelty: It is the first generative AI urban assistant in Italy developed and governed directly by a local public body, designed for radical accessibility without requiring app downloads, registration or prior knowledge of municipal structures. Its super-agent orchestrator coordinating specialized agents represents an advanced step in municipal AI deployment.
stakeholders: Citizens of Rome—particularly the elderly and digitally excluded—who need accessible public services, and municipal administrators seeking to reduce territorial digital divides.
agentic_rationale: JULIA 2.5 introduces a ‘super agent orchestratore’ that coordinates specialized agents, and the system autonomously identifies pertinent services, guides users through correct procedures, and answers questions along the entire path by accessing certified secure knowledge bases to provide direct links and documents.
tech_details: The assistant is available on WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger and web chat, supporting over 80 languages in text and voice. It is integrated directly into Roma Capitale’s institutional portal and retrieves answers from certified, secure knowledge bases.

source_titles.https://www.forumpa.it/pa-digitale/ia-e-: IA e servizi locali: dall’offerta digitale all’accesso universale

name: Leggere i Comuni con l'Intelligenza Artificiale
organisation: Ministero dell'Economia e delle Finanze (MEF) – Dipartimento delle Finanze
description: A pilot initiative presented at FORUM PA 2026 that deploys evolved chatbots powered by agentic AI to interpret complex municipal datasets—including budgets, tax revenues, and territorial data—and suggest analysis paths to support public decision-making. The system demonstrates concrete use cases in analysing local revenues, collection capacity, and equalisation mechanisms without replacing human judgment.
novelty: It applies agentic AI specifically to sub-national public finance, enabling autonomous interpretation and synthesis of fragmented municipal data to generate comparative insights across homogeneous local entities.
stakeholders: Central government analysts, municipal administrations, and citizens who benefit from more informed local fiscal policies.
agentic_rationale: The system uses 'chatbot evoluti basati su IA agentica' that autonomously interpret complex municipal data, select relevant information, and suggest analysis paths to support decisions on local revenues, collection capacity, and equalisation mechanisms.
tech_details: The source describes evolved chatbots using agentic AI and natural-language interaction for municipal data analysis, but does not specify underlying models, platforms, or architecture.

description: Salesforce's planned investment in Solomei AI, developer of the agentic Callimacus platform, requires authorization from the Italian government under the golden power regime for strategically relevant technologies. The transaction, reportedly valuing Solomei AI at €70–100 million, is pending approval by the Presidenza del Consiglio. The deal follows Salesforce's broader $1 billion Italy plan, which includes AI training initiatives for public administration.
novelty: This marks an explicit application of Italy’s golden power foreign-investment screening to the agentic AI sector, treating a private AI-platform deal as strategically critical infrastructure subject to state oversight.
stakeholders: Italian government decision-makers, Salesforce, Solomei AI, the Cucinelli family holding Foro delle Arti, and Italian public administration entities that may benefit from Salesforce’s wider AI training programs.
agentic_rationale: Callimacus uses "diversi agenti di intelligenza artificiale" to interpret what the visitor is looking for and autonomously compose the digital interface during navigation, selecting and combining texts, images, products and other content based on the user's requests and actions without a human initiating each step.
tech_details: Callimacus operates as a separate layer from corporate IT systems and can connect to existing digital and e-commerce platforms without replacing catalogs, archives, warehouses or payment systems.

description: GSA announced a partnership to offer discounted access to GARY, an agentic AI orchestrator with FedRAMP High and IL 5/6 security authorizations, for eligible US federal government customers through the OneGov platform.
novelty: One of the first agentic AI orchestrators with high-level security clearances (FedRAMP High and IL 5/6) being made available government-wide through a federal procurement platform.
stakeholders: US federal agencies eligible for OneGov access; GSA facilitating the partnership; CORAS as the technology provider.
agentic_rationale: The source explicitly classifies the system as an 'agentic AI orchestrator', though specific autonomous decision-making or task coordination capabilities are not detailed.

name: GenAI.mil Pacific Fleet Operational Reporting Agents
description: The GenAI.mil Task Force embedded with the U.S. Pacific Fleet to deliver over 20 custom AI agents that automate operational reporting workflows. The deployment reduced a 3-day operational reporting process to just 1 hour, representing a concrete military implementation of autonomous AI agents.
novelty: This marks one of the first known large-scale deployments of custom AI agents within a U.S. military fleet operational context, achieving dramatic compression of multi-day reporting cycles into minutes through autonomous execution.
stakeholders: U.S. Department of Defense, Pacific Fleet operational personnel, and the GenAI.mil Task Force developers.
agentic_rationale: The agents autonomously execute the complete operational reporting process, reducing a workflow that previously took 3 days to just 1 hour without requiring humans to initiate each individual step.
tech_details: Over 20 custom AI agents developed by the GenAI.mil Task Force; specific models, platforms, or technical architecture were not disclosed in the source.

name: AI-powered authorization procedures for energy installations
description: The Sicilian Regional Government has introduced artificial intelligence tools to accelerate the examination of numerous requests for new energy plants, streamlining the bureaucratic authorization process for renewable energy infrastructure. This is part of the region's broader post-PNRR energy transition strategy that has mobilized approximately half a billion euros in EU funds.
novelty: Applying AI to automate and speed up the evaluation of energy plant authorization requests, moving from manual bureaucratic processing to intelligent automation in a regional government context.
stakeholders: Regional energy planners, energy companies seeking permits, local communities awaiting infrastructure, and citizens benefiting from accelerated clean energy deployment.
agentic_rationale: The AI system autonomously examines and processes the numerous requests for new energy installations to speed up authorization procedures, operating without requiring human initiation of each individual case review. The source states: "introducendo strumenti di intelligenza artificiale per velocizzare l'esame delle numerose richieste di nuovi impianti energetici" (introducing artificial intelligence tools to speed up the examination of numerous requests for new energy plants).
tech_details: AI tools integrated into regional administrative procedures for energy plant permitting; mentioned alongside satellite monitoring and alert systems for other regional digital projects.
