name: FDA Agency-Wide Agentic AI Deployment
description: The FDA is deploying agentic AI capabilities to all agency employees to assist with complex tasks including meeting management, pre-market reviews, post-market surveillance, and inspections. The system operates in a high-security GovCloud environment where models do not train on input data or industry submissions. This follows the agency's earlier deployment of the LLM-based tool Elsa.
novelty: This marks a shift from basic LLM chatbots to autonomous systems capable of planning, reasoning, and executing multi-step actions across scientific and regulatory workflows, representing a major federal deployment of agentic AI for drug and device oversight.
stakeholders: All FDA employees using the system for daily workflows, FDA leadership, and indirectly the regulated industry and public who benefit from enhanced review and surveillance capabilities.
agentic_rationale: The system is designed to "achieve specific goals by planning, reasoning, and executing multi-step actions" including assisting with "complex tasks such as meeting management, pre-market reviews, post-market surveillance, and inspections" without requiring humans to initiate each individual step.
tech_details: Built in a high-security GovCloud environment with guarantees that models do not train on user inputs or regulated industry data; follows the previous LLM-based Elsa tool.

source_titles.https://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-an: FDA Expands Artificial Intelligence Capabilities with Agentic AI Deployment

name: AI Enabled Autonomous Underwater Vehicle
description: CBP is developing a hand-portable, fully autonomous underwater vehicle to detect parasitic smuggling on the outer hulls of maritime vessels at ports of entry. The system uses computer vision and advanced navigation (DVL, USBL, INS) to conduct autonomous inspection missions, detect items of interest, and provide obstacle avoidance, replacing the need for dive teams or larger borrowed ROVs.
novelty: Integrates multiple navigation and communication systems (Doppler Velocity Log, Ultra-Short Baseline, Inertial Navigation System, acoustic/optical modems) into a low-detection-threshold, portable platform capable of fully autonomous underwater missions for hull inspection, specifically targeting narcotics smuggling detection.
stakeholders: CBP Office of Field Operations (OFO) agents and officers, dive teams, strategic law enforcement partners, and vessels entering/exiting U.S. ports.
agentic_rationale: The system conducts "highly reliable, fully autonomous underwater missions" including autonomous navigation, obstacle detection and collision avoidance without human piloting. It autonomously detects items of interest via onboard computer vision, places bounding boxes around suspected anomalies, and notifies users only after detection for review, operating independently throughout the mission duration.
tech_details: Integrates Doppler Velocity Log (DVL), Ultra-Short Baseline (USBL), Inertial Navigation System (INS), acoustic and optical modems with computer vision algorithms for anomaly detection and collision avoidance.

source_titles.https://www.dhs.gov/ai/use-case-inventor: United States Customs and Border Protection

name: OTA Automated Passenger Screening Gate System
description: An automated passenger screening system (Use Case ID: DHS-2397) that regulates expedited traveler screening by using machine vision to assess body positioning and automatically initiate Advanced Imaging Technology (AIT) scans when passengers are in the optimum position. Depending on the scan results, the system autonomously routes passengers either for additional screening or to the rec composure area to reclaim property, thereby managing passenger flow while reducing human interaction.
novelty: Autonomous initiation of security scans and dynamic physical routing of passengers based on real-time machine vision assessment of body positioning, representing a shift from manual checkpoint management to automated queue orchestration.
stakeholders: Transportation Security Officers (TSOs) monitoring the checkpoint and airline passengers undergoing screening.
agentic_rationale: The AI system initiates an AIT scan when the passenger is in the optimum position without human initiation of each scan. Depending on the results of the AIT scan, the passenger is automatically routed either for additional screening or to the rec composure area, executing the routing decision without requiring step-by-step human approval.
tech_details: Machine vision technology for interpreting visual information and assessing body positioning, integrated with Advanced Imaging Technology (AIT) scanners and automated gate routing mechanisms.

name: AlphaWeather AI Agent (알파웨더)
description: Development of an AI agent named AlphaWeather using language models to support weather forecaster operations, alongside Korean AI weather prediction models and a national AI weather-climate foundation model to enable rapid response to changing meteorological conditions and support policy decision-making.
novelty: Creation of a dedicated AI agent (AlphaWeather) specifically designed to assist professional meteorologists using language models, integrated with a sovereign Korean foundation model for weather and climate applications.
stakeholders: Weather forecasters (예보관) at the National Institute of Meteorological Sciences, policymakers using meteorological data for decision-making, and the broader public receiving weather services.
agentic_rationale: The system is explicitly described as an 'AI 에이전트' (AI agent) named AlphaWeather that utilizes language models to autonomously support forecaster operations (예보관 업무지원), indicating it performs tasks to assist forecasters without requiring human initiation of each individual step.
tech_details: Utilizes language models for the AI agent functionality, alongside AI weather prediction models and a Korean AI weather-climate foundation model (한국형 AI 기상·기후 파울데이션 모델); includes AI short-term precipitation prediction and data fusion capabilities.

name: PolyAI
description: PolyAI delivers lifelike voice assistants that handle NS&I customer service inquiries via phone and web chat. Following a phased rollout, 100% of inbound customer calls are now answered by the AI, which uses NLP and LLMs to automate responses to common product and service queries, escalates complex issues to human agents, and handles over 100,000 interactions per month.
novelty: It is a voice-first AI agent deployed at national scale by a UK government body to answer all inbound customer calls 24/7, autonomously deciding whether to contain calls or escalate them based on real-time intent and sentiment analysis.
stakeholders: NS&I customers, NS&I contact centre agents, PolyAI as the vendor, Sopra Steria as the service delivery partner, and Atos as the maintenance partner.
agentic_rationale: The system autonomously answers 100% of inbound customer calls and decides whether to handle queries itself or escalate them to human agents based on intent, sentiment, or topic analysis. It also triggers actions within integrated systems, such as updating records and routing calls, without a human initiating each step.
tech_details: Cloud-based modular architecture using NLP/NLU with neural networks and LLMs for intent recognition, entity extraction, and multi-turn dialogue management. It integrates with the Genesys DX platform and backend APIs, processing voice input via speech recognition and delivering synthesised speech output.

name: Online Cybersquat Hunter (OCH)
organisation: Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX)
description: The OCH uses artificial intelligence with image and text analytics to scan two million sites daily, detecting fake websites that mimic government agencies or news organisations and facilitating their takedown. First deployed in late 2020 to protect Ministry of Home Affairs sites, it has been extended to other government organisations and identified over 10 fake news websites during a 2022 trial, contributing to the blocking of approximately 20,000 scam websites.
novelty: Autonomous daily scanning of millions of sites using combined image and text analytics to detect cybersquatting and visual impersonation, with automated takedown capabilities and extension to track resurrected scam sites through database matching.
stakeholders: Singaporean citizens (potential scam victims), HTX Q Team (developers), Ministry of Home Affairs and other government agencies (users), and police (site blocking).
agentic_rationale: The OCH autonomously executes daily scans of two million sites and takes down detected fake ones without human initiation of each individual action, as described by its capability of 'picking up fake ones and taking them down'. Additionally, Synweb automatically checks sites against databases to identify resurrected scams, and the Scam-Site Indicator automatically predicts scam probability.
tech_details: Utilises artificial intelligence with image and text analytics for detection, machine learning algorithms for scam prediction, and database matching capabilities for identifying resurrected sites with different domains.

source_titles.https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/f: Fake ST, Zaobao and CNA news sites that promote gambling detected and blocked

name: Uranos KI
description: Procurement of an AI-supported reconnaissance network combining unmanned aerial and ground vehicles (drones and UGVs) with multi-sensor fusion (optical, radar, acoustic, seismic) for battalion-level battlefield reconnaissance. The system processes large volumes of sensor data to generate situational awareness and information superiority for tactical command posts, with initial systems to be delivered to Panzerbrigade 45 in Lithuania between 2026 and 2028.
novelty: First deployment of AI at the battalion level in the German Army; introduces a novel competitive procurement mechanism where contractors (Airbus/Quantum Systems vs. Helsing) compete through the development phase until delivery of functional systems, with underperformance risking loss of follow-on orders rather than just contractual penalties.
stakeholders: German Army (Panzerbrigade 45), battalion commanders and tactical operations centres, technology providers Airbus Defence and Space, Quantum Systems, and Helsing.
agentic_rationale: The unmanned systems execute missions "weitgehend selbstständig" (largely independently) due to a high degree of automation, and the AI proactively suggests specific reconnaissance deployments—such as proposing drone and UGV missions to investigate seismic detections or track changes identified in video analysis—without requiring human initiation of each analytical step or platform dispatch.
tech_details: Hardware and software integration of market-available components into a holistic system featuring a central control station for simultaneous planning and control of multiple unmanned platforms; centralised fusion of data from optical, radar, acoustic and seismic sensors to create unified situational awareness.

source_titles.https://www.hartpunkt.de/uranos-ki-kuens: Uranos KI: Künstliche Intelligenz für die Gefechtsaufklärung der Bataillonsebene

name: Mobile Phone Detection Camera Program
description: The Mobile Phone Detection Camera Program uses AI-powered fixed and transportable cameras across New South Wales to detect drivers illegally using mobile phones. The system captures images of passing vehicles in all traffic and weather conditions, uses artificial intelligence to automatically review images and detect potential offenses, and since 1 July 2024 has also enforced seatbelt non-compliance.
novelty: The system employs AI to autonomously review images in real-time, automatically excluding and permanently deleting images of non-offending drivers within an hour while routing potential offenses to human reviewers, representing a scalable automated enforcement mechanism that has expanded from phone use to seatbelt compliance.
stakeholders: NSW drivers, NSW Police, Revenue NSW, Transport for NSW, the NSW Privacy Commissioner, and the program's camera vendor.
agentic_rationale: Artificial intelligence software automatically reviews images and detects potential offending drivers. It excludes images of non-offending drivers from further action. Images rejected by the artificial intelligence are permanently and irretrievably deleted, typically within an hour of detection.
tech_details: The system uses multiple cameras and an infra-red flash to capture clear images of passing vehicles in all traffic and weather conditions. Artificial intelligence software automatically reviews the images to detect potential mobile phone and seatbelt offenses before human verification.

name: France Travail AI Suite (ChatFT, MatchFT, Neo)
description: France Travail presented at VivaTech 2025 its AI-powered employment service tools including ChatFT (a generative AI assistant used by 40,000+ agents for document drafting), MatchFT (autonomous candidate pre-selection via SMS conversations), ChatFT Ecoute (automated interview transcription and data entry), and Neo (natural language interface to internal systems). The initiatives aim to reduce administrative burden on advisors and improve job seeker experience through sovereign AI partnerships.
novelty: Deployment of semi-autonomous agentic capabilities where MatchFT independently contacts and questions pre-selected candidates via SMS to verify prerequisites, and ChatFT Ecoute automatically captures, synthesizes and enters interview data into information systems without per-action human initiation. The suite also marks a shift toward sovereign AI through a partnership with Mistral AI targeting 100% usage for key tools by end-2025.
stakeholders: France Travail advisors and agents (40,000+ users), job seekers (300,000 training target), employers recruiting through the service, and technology partners Mistral AI, Microsoft and Kokoroe.
agentic_rationale: MatchFT autonomously contacts pre-selected candidates by SMS to question them about their interest in job offers and verify prerequisites (workplace access, availability, task capacity). ChatFT Ecoute captures verbal exchanges during interviews, synthesizes them and automates data entry into the information system, allowing advisors to focus on the human interaction.
tech_details: Built on Mistral AI models (targeting 100% usage for MatchFT and Neo in 2025), Microsoft technologies for the training platform, and natural language processing for Neo's database queries and QualifFT's voice interfaces. ChatFT Ecoute is being tested in Pays de la Loire and Centre-Val de Loire agencies.

source_titles.https://www.francetravail.org/accueil/co: France Travail présente à VivaTech 2025 ses nouveautés en matière d’IA
source_titles.https://www.lagazettefrance.fr/article/c: Chez France Travail, l'IA s'installe, pour les agents et les demandeur ...

name: Personnel Action Request (PAR) Agent
description: Workday Government is launching an AI agent to automate federal personnel actions including hiring, promotion, transfer, and separation within its Human Capital Management (HCM) platform. Expected to be available in March 2027, the tool aims to reduce processing time from 44 days per step to roughly a third of that, replacing manual processes across disparate agency systems in alignment with the Trump administration's HR 2.0 modernization initiative.
novelty: It represents one of the first agentic AI deployments specifically designed for federal HR modernization, moving beyond chatbot-style response generation to autonomously execute multi-step personnel workflows across government agencies using a standardized, configurable platform rather than customized legacy code.
stakeholders: Federal agencies including the Department of Energy, Defense Information Systems Agency, and U.S. Space Force; HR staff processing personnel actions; federal employees undergoing hiring, promotion, or separation; Workday Government; and the Office of Personnel Management (OPM).
agentic_rationale: The PAR Agent carries out specific programmed tasks autonomously to automate processes for personnel actions such as hiring, promotion, transfer, and separation using data on the Workday platform, rather than merely generating responses like a chatbot. It executes these multi-step workflows without requiring human initiation of each individual step, cutting processing time from 44 days per step to almost a third of that.
tech_details: Embedded within Workday's existing Human Capital Management (HCM) system and Workday Government platform, the agent uses data residing on the Workday platform to automate workflows. It runs on the same code base as commercial offerings with configuration management capabilities rather than customization, designed for regular upgrades and interoperability with other agentic tools.

source_titles.https://fedscoop.com/workday-trump-hr-ov: Workday Government has Trump’s HR overhaul in mind with coming agentic AI tool

name: Virginia Agentic AI Regulatory Reduction Pilot
organisation: Commonwealth of Virginia (Virginia Office of Regulatory Management)
description: Virginia launched a pilot program under Executive Order 51 (2025) deploying agentic AI to scan existing state regulations and guidance documents. The system identifies opportunities to streamline regulations, flags contradictions with state statute, detects redundancies, and highlights language improvements to help agencies achieve a 25 percent regulatory reduction target. The initiative is the first of its kind at the state level and will be followed by a requirement for agencies to use AI in regular four-year regulatory reviews.
novelty: This is the first U.S. state to deploy an agentic AI tool specifically to power the regulatory reduction and review process, moving beyond generative AI to autonomous analysis of legal and regulatory corpora.
stakeholders: Virginia state agencies conducting regulatory reviews, the Virginia Office of Regulatory Management, state citizens and businesses benefiting from reduced regulatory burden, and the Virginia AI Task Force providing policy oversight.
agentic_rationale: The AI tool autonomously scans the entire corpus of existing regulations and guidance documents to identify streamlining opportunities, flag areas where regulations contradict state statute, identify redundancies, and highlight specific language that can be improved without a human initiating each individual comparison or analysis step.
tech_details: The system is described as agentic AI with autonomous decision-making capabilities distinct from generative AI, though specific models, platforms, or technical architectures are not detailed in the source.

source_titles.https://www.govtech.com/artificial-intel: Virginia to Use Agentic AI to Power Review of Regulations

name: Physical AI Smart Port Strategy
description: South Korea unveiled a national strategy to transform ports into fully autonomous logistics systems using physical AI. The plan involves testing technologies at Gwangyang Port before deploying them at Jinhae New Port (opening 2032), featuring 198 autonomous cranes, 171 automated guided vehicles and an AI-based terminal operating system. The initiative aims to increase port productivity by 30%, prevent workplace accidents, and capture 10% of the global port equipment market by 2035.
novelty: The strategy treats the entire port as "one enormous intelligent robot" where physical AI systems autonomously perceive surroundings, make decisions and control machinery, moving beyond unmanned automation toward coordinated autonomous operation of all cargo-handling equipment as a single integrated system.
stakeholders: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, port operators, private terminal operators, domestic equipment suppliers, manufacturing companies in shipbuilding and defense, port workers and specialists, and international partners including the United Arab Emirates and UN ESCAP.
agentic_rationale: Cranes, automated guided vehicles and cargo-handling equipment will "assess surrounding conditions and operate autonomously" using "AI-based perception, decision-making and control" to execute mooring operations and cargo handling without human initiation of each step, creating a system where "an entire port operates like one enormous intelligent robot."
tech_details: Physical AI systems including an AI-based terminal operating system, 198 autonomous cranes (36 ship-to-shore and 162 yard cranes), 171 automated guided vehicles, AI data centers in port hinterlands, and strengthened cybersecurity safeguards for connected autonomous systems.

source_titles.https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/: South Korea unveils AI-powered smart port strategy

name: Xylo Planning AI
description: Xylo is a GovTech startup deploying AI agents to automate administrative tasks for local government planning officers. The system is designed to keep human judgement in control while increasing efficiency, with early traction at Leeds City Council demonstrating a 40% increase in planning applications processed.
novelty: It applies agentic AI specifically to planning officer administration—traditionally paper-heavy and slow—while explicitly architecting for human-in-the-loop oversight rather than full automation. The early measurable efficiency gain (40% throughput increase) provides concrete evidence of impact in a high-stakes regulatory context.
stakeholders: Local government planning officers (primary users), Leeds City Council (pilot site), and planning applicants (beneficiaries of faster processing).
agentic_rationale: The system employs 'AI agents' to 'automate admin for local government planning officers', executing administrative tasks and workflows without requiring human initiation of each step, while maintaining 'human judgement in control' for oversight and final decisions.
tech_details: Not specified in the source beyond reference to 'AI agents'.

source_titles.https://x.com/SheetVenture/status/207228: Xylo Raises £2.8M Pre-Seed for UK GovTech AI

name: GenAI.mil Gemini 3.1 Pro deployment
description: The Pentagon has deployed Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro model across its federal AI platform GenAI.mil. US government workers have reportedly built more than 100,000 AI agents on the platform.
novelty: This represents a massive, department-wide rollout of a commercial generative AI model explicitly used to create AI agents, with over 100,000 agents reportedly built by federal workers.
stakeholders: US Department of Defense and other federal government workers building agents on the platform, with Google providing the underlying model.
agentic_rationale: The source states that US government workers have already built over 100,000 AI agents on the GenAI.mil platform, though it does not detail the specific autonomous tasks these agents perform.
tech_details: Google Gemini 3.1 Pro model integrated into the Pentagon's GenAI.mil federal AI platform.

source_titles.https://x.com/BennyLam/status/2048858390: The Pentagon just deployed Gemini 3.1 Pro across its entire federal AI platform http://GenAI.mil

name: Tucson Service Delivery AI Agent
description: The City of Tucson issued a request for proposals for an AI-powered service automation solution to serve as the municipality's first agentic AI deployment. The system will function as both an LLM chatbot for information provision and as an operational agent capable of processing requests and updating records within city systems, initially piloting with the IT service desk and Tucson Water Customer Service.
novelty: This represents Tucson's first venture into agentic AI, explicitly moving beyond simple chatbots to deploy an autonomous agent that can perform staff-like actions by connecting to internal business tools and systems of record.
stakeholders: City residents seeking services, call center and IT help desk staff (who will be augmented rather than replaced), Tucson Water customers, and external AI vendors responding to the RFP.
agentic_rationale: The system is designed to "act as an agent with the means to process requests, update records, and perform like a staffer," connecting to Tucson's business tools and systems of record to execute tasks autonomously rather than merely providing information.
tech_details: Large language model-based chatbot trained on the city's business knowledge base and practices, integrated with internal business tools and systems of record. Implementation will be phased, beginning with the IT Department service desk before expanding to Tucson Water Customer Service.

source_titles.https://www.govtech.com/artificial-intel: Tucson, Ariz., Seeks AI Agent to Support Service Delivery

name: Agent Network
description: Agent Network is the second of seven Pace-Setting Projects under the Department of War’s AI Strategy released January 9, 2026, employing AI-enabled agents to compress intelligence into commander options for battle management at "wartime speed." The system integrates with the modernized War Data Platform (formerly Advana) to provide standardized data access across combatant commands, while explicitly not autonomously selecting or striking targets.
novelty: It represents a department-wide push to operationalize agentic AI across U.S. Pacific, Southern, and European Commands, supported by a CTO-led innovation operating system with a dedicated barrier-removal team empowered to escalate impediments to the Deputy Secretary, and mandates rapid Authorization to Operate reciprocity for cross-domain data access.
stakeholders: Led by the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office in partnership with U.S. Pacific Command, U.S. Southern Command, and U.S. European Command, with technology partners Palantir Technologies and Lumbra, within a broader ecosystem including the Defense Innovation Unit, Strategic Capabilities Office, and private capital partners.
agentic_rationale: The system employs AI-enabled agents to compress intelligence into commander options, autonomously processing and synthesizing data to present decision-ready courses of action without a human initiating each step, transforming battle management workflows through agentic decision support.
tech_details: Built on partner technologies including Palantir Technologies' Maven Smart System and Lumbra, integrated with the War Data Platform (modernized from Advana) for standardized data access, featuring cross-domain data access with rapid ATO reciprocity and access to latest AI model versions within 30 days of public release.

source_titles.https://www.war.gov/News/Releases/Releas: DOW Unleashes 'Agent Network' to Transform AI-Enabled Battle Management and Targeting

name: Agentic AI Implementation in Federal Tax Authority Operations
organisation: Federal Tax Authority (FTA) of the UAE
description: The UAE Federal Tax Authority is directed to implement self-executing and self-directed AI models (Agentic AI) within two years as part of a broader government transformation targeting 50% of government sectors, services and operations. The initiative aims to re-engineer operational processes for sustainable smart performance, enabling national talent to focus on strategic planning, oversight and innovation while creating a proactive system that makes decisions with extreme precision and unprecedented speed in all aspects of financial administration.
novelty: This represents a shift from digital services to self-governing systems where AI moves from a support tool to the core of government operations, with the tax authority serving as a pilot for the broader UAE government transformation.
stakeholders: Federal Tax Authority staff, UAE citizens (particularly homeowners seeking VAT refunds), corporate and individual taxpayers, tax agents, and national government leadership.
agentic_rationale: The system is explicitly described as 'نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي ذاتية التنفيذ والقيادة' (self-executing and self-directing AI models) that create 'منظومة استباقية تتخذ القرارات بدقة متناهية وسرعة غير مسبوقة في جميع جوانب الإدارة المالية' (a proactive system that takes decisions with extreme precision and unprecedented speed in all aspects of financial administration), transforming AI from 'أداة دعم إلى منظومة ترسم ملامح حكومة تُدار بالذكاء الاصطناعي' (a support tool to a system that designs the features of an AI-managed government).
tech_details: Integration with existing digital platforms including 'إمارات تاكس' (Emirates Tax) digital services platform, payment gateways (Magnati, GIBAN), and electronic invoicing systems linked with Ministry of Finance.

source_titles.https://www.emaratalyoum.com/business/lo: مكتوم بن محمد يوجّه «الاتحادية للضرائب» بتطبيق نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي ذاتية التنفيذ خلال عامين

name: AI Agent Digital Identity Framework
description: Estonia is developing a national framework to grant official digital identities to AI agents, enabling them to autonomously carry out tasks such as compiling reports, preparing declarations, interacting with information systems, and making payments on behalf of citizens and companies. The system allows users to delegate limited, controllable powers to agents—such as view-only access, document preparation, or financial limits—rather than granting blanket access to all rights and data. This builds upon Estonia's existing digital infrastructure including the X-Road, digital signatures, and citizen digital identities.
novelty: It establishes the world's first national digital identity infrastructure specifically for AI agents, creating a legal and technical mechanism for delegated agency where autonomous systems can act with distinct, limited powers (e.g., specific financial caps or document types) separate from the full rights of the human or entity they represent.
stakeholders: Estonian citizens, companies, government agencies interacting with delegated agents, AI developers, and the defence industry for the associated 'Merepesa' drone testing initiative.
agentic_rationale: AI agents will "carry out digital tasks on our behalf, compiling reports, preparing declarations or interacting with information systems," and can be delegated specific powers to "prepare a document, draw up a payment or act solely within a specific financial limit" without requiring the human to initiate each individual step or grant blanket access to all services and data.
tech_details: Builds upon Estonia's existing digital state infrastructure including the X-Road data exchange layer, digital signatures, and citizen digital identity systems; specific AI models or agent architectures not detailed.

source_titles.https://www.valitsus.ee/en/news/prime-mi: Prime Minister Michal: Estonia to become first country to create digital identities for AI agents

name: UAE Government AI Agents (Four Service Agents)
description: The UAE government unveiled four AI agents at a national retreat on May 20, 2026, to automate federal public services spanning procurement, tax auditing, customer support, and IT technical support. The initiative marks the first major step toward the government's goal of converting 50 per cent of all government services and operations to AI-powered systems within two years. The launch event was attended by over 400 ministers and federal officials, including the Vice President and Prime Minister.
novelty: This represents the UAE's first major deployment of agentic AI across federal government operations, explicitly moving beyond simple automation to autonomous agents that independently manage high-volume administrative functions such as purchasing, compliance audits, and IT maintenance.
stakeholders: Primary users are federal government employees in procurement, tax, customer service, and IT departments; beneficiaries include UAE citizens and residents receiving streamlined public services, and the government itself through operational efficiency gains.
agentic_rationale: The four agents autonomously execute government purchasing and sourcing, conduct tax compliance checks and audits to cut audit times, manage customer service responses to improve speed and quality, and resolve IT issues to keep digital services running without requiring human initiation of each individual task.
tech_details: Specific technical architecture, underlying models, and integration platforms were not disclosed in the announcement, though the initiative was presented alongside ADNOC's ENERGYai platform which connects agents across supply chains.

source_titles.https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/uae-age: UAE rolls out 4 AI agents to run public services, from tax auditing to customer support

name: AI Agents for Public Sector
organisation: Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT), Philippines
description: The Philippine DICT has partnered with Google Cloud to deploy Gemini Enterprise AI tools to over 50,000 public servants initially, with plans to reach 200,000 within 18 months. The initiative enables public servants to build context-aware AI agents that handle citizen inquiries in local languages, query previously siloed databases (e.g., pulling up pending building permit applications), and deploy agentic taskforces to analyse agricultural supply chain anomalies. The partnership also includes a cross-agency cyber defence alliance using Google Cloud Cybershield and upgrades to subsea cable infrastructure to support AI bandwidth demands.
novelty: The deployment represents a large-scale government rollout of agentic AI with specific autonomous capabilities for supply chain analysis and cross-database querying, integrated with Google Workspace for seamless inter-agency collaboration. It uniquely combines citizen-facing AI services with national cybersecurity infrastructure (Cybershield for 56+ agencies) and subsea cable upgrades as a unified digital transformation programme.
stakeholders: Public servants (50,000 initially, 200,000 target), citizens receiving government services, 56 government agencies (targeting 90 by June 2026) participating in the cyber defence alliance, and Google Cloud as the technology provider.
agentic_rationale: Public servants can 'deploy an agentic taskforce to analyse agricultural supply chain anomalies', allowing autonomous analysis of complex data patterns without human initiation of each analytical step. The agents can independently handle citizen inquiries in local languages and query 'previously siloed databases' through context-aware interactions.
tech_details: Built on Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with Google Workspace connectors for document synthesis and inter-agency collaboration. Includes Google Cloud Cybershield for AI-driven cyber defence with Gemini-assisted security operations and Mandiant expertise. Supported by upgraded subsea infrastructure including the Taiwan-Philippines-US (TPU) and Apricot cable systems using next-generation multicore fibre technology.

source_titles.https://www.computerweekly.com/news/3666: Philippine government taps Google Cloud to deploy AI agents

name: AlemGPT
organisation: Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development
description: Kazakhstan is piloting AlemGPT, a multi-agent AI platform designed to provide citizens and businesses with end-to-end public services through a single conversational interface. Users describe their needs in natural language, and the system suggests relevant services and assists with online applications, covering the full chain from initial request to final result.
novelty: The initiative marks a shift from traditional e-government website navigation to a dialog-based, multi-agent system that orchestrates the entire service delivery chain within a single platform. It aims to eliminate the need for citizens and businesses to manually search across different services by instead interpreting natural language descriptions of their situations.
stakeholders: Citizens and businesses of Kazakhstan are the end users, while the Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development is responsible for development and testing.
agentic_rationale: The source explicitly describes AlemGPT as a 'multi-agent platform' that will deliver 'full-cycle public services on a single platform – from the initial request to the final result,' where the user 'describes their situation in text, after which the system suggests which public services are available and helps to apply for them online' without switching between different services.
tech_details: AlemGPT is described as a multi-agent AI platform with a conversational chat interface similar to ChatGPT, intended to replace manual navigation on the eGov website.

source_titles.https://en.tengrinews.kz/kazakhstan_news: All public services to be moved to AlemGPT in Kazakhstan

name: Samadhan Didi
organisation: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG), Government of India
description: An AI-enabled voice chatbot launched to allow citizens to lodge grievances against government departments orally in their own language via the Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS). The system eliminates the need for users to know specific ministries, departments or categories by automatically classifying and routing complaints to the correct authority.
novelty: Enables natural language, voice-based grievance submission in plain words without requiring citizens to navigate administrative hierarchies or know specific departmental categories; integrates with Bhashini for multilingual support beyond the 22 constitutional languages.
stakeholders: Indian citizens filing grievances against government departments, DARPG, state governments encouraged to adopt the tool, and the Bhashini platform.
agentic_rationale: The chatbot autonomously interprets spoken natural language descriptions of concerns, asks clarifying questions to gather necessary information, decides the appropriate ministry, department, category and sub-category for the grievance, and executes the filing with the correct authority without requiring human intervention in the routing decision.
tech_details: Developed by DARPG in collaboration with Bhashini (AI language platform), built on secure government infrastructure, integrating Bhashini's multilingual language capabilities with grievance-classification models trained on CPGRAMS data.

source_titles.https://www.etvbharat.com/en/technology/: Centre Unveils AI-Enabled Chatbot To Help Citizens Launch Grievances Online

name: DOLA (Department of Labor Agent)
description: The U.S. Department of Labor has deployed DOLA, an autonomous AI agent powered by Salesforce Agentforce, within its National Contact Center to provide 24/7 citizen support. The system automates intake details collection, opens formal cases for programs including Unemployment Insurance and Job Corps, and triages inquiries with 'hospital-like precision' before escalating to human staff when needed.
novelty: DOLA moves beyond simple chatbots to autonomous task execution, independently opening cases, processing applications, and managing escalation paths without human initiation for each step. It represents a shift from reactive service to proactive 'agentic enterprise' operations within federal government.
stakeholders: American workers, retirees, employers, veterans, job seekers, and DOL contact center staff handling 28 different DOL programs including Unemployment Insurance, OSHA, and Job Corps.
agentic_rationale: DOLA 'collects intake details, opens formal cases, responds empathetically, and launches escalation paths autonomously' for Unemployment Insurance and other programs. It independently triages citizen needs with 'hospital-like precision' to direct resources toward critical worker needs without requiring human initiation for each case opening or escalation decision.
tech_details: Built on Salesforce Agentforce and Agentforce 360 Platform using Salesforce Government Cloud (FedRAMP High). Uses Data 360 to harmonize data from 2,900+ verified knowledge articles and third-party systems. Integrates Tableau Next for analytics and Salesforce Voice for telephony, supporting over 100 developers in a sandbox environment.

source_titles.https://www.salesforce.com/news/press-re: U.S. Department of Labor Taps Agentforce to Enhance Citizen Support

name: AI Government Lab
organisation: Ministry of the Interior and Safety (MOIS)
description: A lab enabling civil servants to use vibe coding and AI agents to rapidly prototype solutions for manual and repetitive administrative tasks. The pilot phase allows use of commercial cloud services, AI coding tools, and public APIs, with plans to expand into the internal government network next year to enable secure access to administrative data. A Public Development Repository (Public GitLab) will centrally manage code and prompts for cross-agency reuse.
novelty: Frontline civil servants directly build AI agents and applications via vibe coding rather than relying on traditional lengthy IT procurement cycles. The initiative establishes a 'Public AX Portal' to crowdsource improvement ideas from citizens and civil servants while institutionalizing a Public GitLab for government-wide code reuse.
stakeholders: Civil servants (primary users developing prototypes), citizens (beneficiaries of improved services and contributors via the Public AX Portal), and private-sector experts (consultants for the portal).
agentic_rationale: The system provides 'development environments for task-specific AI agents tailored to individual administrative functions', enabling agents to execute specific administrative tasks autonomously as 'colleagues' to civil servants. These agents handle defined operational functions without requiring human initiation of each step, working alongside employees to transform workplace improvement ideas into working prototypes.
tech_details: Utilizes commercial cloud services, AI coding tools for vibe coding, open data, and public APIs during the pilot, with expansion to internal networks planned for secure access to agency documents, laws, and civil complaint cases. Centralized through a Public Development Repository (Public GitLab) for source code and AI prompt management.

Korea to Launch 'AI Government Lab' to Let Civil Servants Build AI Solutions

name: AI Assistant Desk (AI Agent Registry)
description: GovTech Singapore is developing a registry within its AI Assistant Desk suite to track AI agent ownership and activities among approximately 150,000 public officers. The system provides visibility over autonomous agent usage for tasks such as drafting reports, managing schedules, and writing code, and includes customizable security guardrails. It is currently being piloted ahead of a broader rollout planned for late 2026.
novelty: The initiative establishes a centralized accountability infrastructure with a registry tracking agent ownership and actions, combined with customizable security guardrails that block unauthorized actions like file deletion or external emailing regardless of which AI tools are used. This represents a systematic approach to governing semi-autonomous AI agents at scale across the entire public sector workforce.
stakeholders: Public officers (150,000 intended users), GovTech Singapore as the implementing agency, and government agencies adopting the AI Assistant Desk suite.
agentic_rationale: The AI agents "can proactively work out the steps needed to complete a task with minimal or no human input," enabling autonomous execution of tasks such as drafting reports, managing schedules, and writing codes through natural language prompts without requiring technical expertise or step-by-step human initiation.
tech_details: The system comprises the AI Assistant Desk suite with an integrated registry for tracking agent metadata and activities, featuring a customizable rules layer and security guardrails that prevent file deletion and restrict external emailing. It supports integration of both in-house and third-party AI tools and includes automated checks to catch offensive language.

source_titles.https://govinsider.asia/intl-en/article/: Singapore gears up to scale public sector's use of AI agents in later 2026

name: HKGAI Governed AI Agent Network
description: HKGAI is poised to launch an open-source human-AI agent collaboration network in which agents operate under a governance framework with distinct ‘social identities’ and strict operational boundaries. Alongside the network, the hub is rolling out AI products to assist citizens with school selection, budgeting and horse-racing data analysis.
novelty: It is described as the world’s first open-source governed AI agent network, introducing a framework that assigns AI agents distinct ‘social identities’ and operational boundaries to enable traceable autonomous collaboration.
stakeholders: Citizens using the school selection, budgeting and racing data tools; developers and organisations participating in the HKGAI agent network; and the Hong Kong government through the InnoHK programme.
agentic_rationale: The source states that, under the proposed governance framework, ‘AI agents could autonomously execute tasks and collaborate across the network within strictly defined limits’, with humans retaining authorisation and decision-making power but agents acting on their own initiative within those bounds.
tech_details: Open-source network architecture with a proposed governance framework assigning social identities and operational boundaries to AI agents; specific models or underlying platforms are not stated.

source_titles.https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/334677: HKGAI to launch world’s first governed AI agent network amid OpenClaw frenzy

name: CDC AI Strategy and Agentic AI Guidance
organisation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
description: The CDC launched its first agency-specific AI strategy and guidance documents for state, tribal, local and territorial (STLT) public health authorities. The strategy promotes AI adoption, workforce empowerment, and governance while specifically encouraging 'agentic' or 'deep research' uses that autonomously carry out tasks. Almost 10% of CDC's roughly 100 AI use cases in 2025 were agentic tools, representing roughly a third of such deployments across HHS.
novelty: This is CDC's first dedicated AI strategy, distinct from the broader HHS strategy, formalizing policy for an agency that has used AI for decades. Uniquely, it explicitly endorses 'agentic' AI uses and provides specific guidance for external public health partners on deploying autonomous deep research tools based on CDC's internal validation studies.
stakeholders: CDC staff, state/tribal/local/territorial (STLT) public health authorities, Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), and the general public receiving improved public health services.
agentic_rationale: The CDC is deploying 'deep research' tools that autonomously carry out specific tasks such as reviewing literature, data, policy and other sources to inform decision-making—work that normally requires staff to conduct a 'three- to four-hour deep dive into a subject' to build reference sets. The tool conducts rapid information synthesis autonomously without a human initiating each step of the research process.
tech_details: The strategy leverages enterprise solutions from HHS and includes tools capable of 'deep research' and literature synthesis. CDC was the first federal agency to roll out ChatGPT to all workers in 2023, and the current agentic tools integrate with information-rich sources such as CDC's own publications.

source_titles.https://fedscoop.com/cdc-releases-ai-str: CDC releases AI strategy, guidance with eye toward ‘agentic’ uses

name: Abu Dhabi Digital Strategy 2025-2027 AI-Powered Government
organisation: Abu Dhabi Government / Department of Government Enablement
description: Abu Dhabi has committed AED 13 billion ($3.5 billion) to AI-driven digital transformation through its Digital Strategy 2025-2027, aiming to establish the world's first fully AI-powered government by 2027. The initiative includes automating all government processes and integrating sovereign cloud computing across operations.
novelty: The strategy explicitly targets becoming the world's first fully AI-powered government with complete automation of government processes, not just selective digitization.
stakeholders: Abu Dhabi government agencies, public sector employees, citizens and residents receiving government services, and private sector companies in the emirate.
agentic_rationale: The strategy aims to "automate all government processes" and establish "the world's first fully AI-powered government by 2027," indicating autonomous execution of government workflows without human initiation of each step. A Dubai logistics firm case study cites "AI-powered automation for invoice processing and payment reconciliation" with "streamlined operations across multiple UAE locations."
tech_details: Sovereign cloud computing integration across government operations; multi-language Arabic and English processing; integration with UAE banking and ERP systems.

source_titles.https://beam.ai/agentic-insights/ai-agen: AI Agents UAE Reduce Manual Work in 2026

name: AI+ Action Plan
description: China's five-year policy blueprint released March 2026, mentioning AI over 50 times and including a sweeping 'AI+ action plan' to aggressively adopt AI across the economy. The plan aims for breakthroughs in chips, quantum computing, humanoid robots, and other technologies, with specific provisions for experimenting with robots to address labor shortages and deploying AI agents.
novelty: The plan explicitly frames AI agent deployment as a national priority alongside humanoid robots, marking a shift from general AI adoption to autonomous systems integration in economic planning.
stakeholders: Chinese government agencies, state-owned enterprises, technology companies, manufacturing sectors facing labor shortages, and open-source AI communities.
agentic_rationale: The blueprint specifically calls for 'deploying AI agents' and 'experimenting with robots for labor shortages' — indicating autonomous systems that can act to address workforce gaps without human initiation of each task.
tech_details: Emphasizes breakthroughs in chips, quantum computing, and humanoid robots; promotes open-source AI communities and technological self-reliance.

source_titles.https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacif: China's new five-year plan calls for AI throughout its economy, tech breakthroughs

name: State Department Agentic AI Rollout
description: The State Department plans to deploy agentic AI systems that operate autonomously to complete complex tasks and make decisions without human direction. The initiative aims to reduce administrative friction by embedding AI agents on top of expensive-to-maintain legacy systems, including consular applications for visas and passports, building upon the existing StateChat internal chatbot platform.
novelty: Moving beyond generative AI tools for translation and summarization to autonomous agents capable of independent decision-making and complex task completion without human-in-the-loop direction, specifically targeting legacy system modernization.
stakeholders: State Department employees and diplomats at embassies; beneficiaries include consular services applicants via modernized backend systems; IT and AI workforce enablement teams.
agentic_rationale: The systems will "operate autonomously" and "complete more complex tasks and make decisions without direction from a human in the loop," specifically to "slap AI agents on top of older systems" that are expensive to maintain and lack resilience, allowing autonomous handling of administrative and system maintenance tasks.
tech_details: Built upon the existing StateChat platform which uses custom GPTs; includes a mobile version for government-issued devices; planned integration with legacy consular applications and underlying systems requiring modernization.

source_titles.https://fedscoop.com/state-department-ag: State Department is gearing up to ‘roll out agentic AI’

name: Space Threat Analysis and Response System (STARS)
description: STARS is an AI-driven prototype for autonomous space domain awareness and threat response. It ingests data from ground-based networks and commercial surveillance providers to predict hazards such as close approaches between satellites or interference in low Earth orbit, evaluates threat characteristics almost instantly, and generates prioritized response options to protect Australian and allied space assets.
novelty: The system provides autonomous, near real-time analysis and response planning for space threats at 'machine speed', integrating predictive analytics with rapid-response orbital vehicles (Optimus Viper) to enable coordinated physical inspection and protection missions.
stakeholders: Australian Department of Defence, Space Machines Company, allied partners including AUKUS and Quad nations, and satellite operators requiring protection.
agentic_rationale: The system autonomously evaluates threat characteristics, assesses risks to specific satellites, and generates prioritized response options without requiring human initiation of each analytical step, enabling operators to shift from detection to action at 'machine speed'.
tech_details: Built on Space Machines Company's Solstice OS AI-driven command-and-control platform, STARS integrates data from ground-based space domain awareness networks and commercial providers, with planned integration with Optimus Viper Rapid Response Vehicles for on-orbit servicing and protection.

source_titles.https://www.hngn.com/articles/269447/202: Australian Firm Wins $2.9 Million Defence Contract to Build AI-Powered Space Threat Detection System

name: Qatar AI Agents Initiative
organisation: Qatar Government (Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology and other agencies)
description: A five-year partnership with Scale AI to develop AI agents across multiple government sectors including civil service, healthcare, transportation, tourism, and education. Specific applications include AI agents for drafting and reviewing contracts, legal and regulatory guidance, automated construction permits, licensing portals, medical scribes, and customs automation.
novelty: One of the first comprehensive national deployments of AI agents across government functions in the Middle East, with explicit use of 'AI agent' terminology for contract drafting, legal guidance, and operational tasks.
stakeholders: Qatar government agencies, Scale AI, citizens receiving government services, students and teachers in schools, healthcare patients, tourists, and transportation users.
agentic_rationale: The system includes 'an AI agent for drafting and reviewing contracts' and 'an agent for legal and regulatory guidance' that operate autonomously on these tasks. The DOD 'Thunderforge' program referenced as comparable work involves 'AI agents for U.S. military planning and operations'.
tech_details: AI voice, chat and email agents for contact centers; Scale AI's platform with integration into existing government systems; personalized learning platform and AI teacher assistant.

source_titles.https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/16/scale-ai: Scale AI working with Qatar to develop AI agents for education, health care and transportation

name: TAMM
description: AI-powered platform providing approximately 950 Abu Dhabi government services to 2.5 million citizens, residents and businesses. The app handles over 10 million transactions annually including car registration, visa renewals and fine payments, using an AI assistant to navigate complex processes and automate tasks like insurance policy selection and synchronization with vehicle registration.
novelty: Integration of nearly 1,000 services from multiple government entities into a single platform powered by sovereign cloud (G42) combined with Azure OpenAI. The AI assistant autonomously synchronizes across systems (e.g., matching insurance start dates with registration) and proactively updates users on request progress, with upcoming voice-enabled task execution capabilities.
stakeholders: Abu Dhabi citizens, residents and businesses; government entities delivering integrated services; People of Determination (POD) requiring accessibility support; TAMM Factory operations team.
agentic_rationale: The AI assistant recommends insurance policies and synchronizes them with car registration automatically without user intervention for coordination, and manages follow-up by updating users on the progress of reported issues like infrastructure repairs. Future updates will enable users to delegate task execution via spoken commands.
tech_details: Built on Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service and G42 Compass 2.0 sovereign cloud platform. Utilizes JAIS (Arabic LLM) and Azure OpenAI GPT-4 models. Currently in version 3.0 with voice conversation features planned for imminent release.

source_titles.https://news.microsoft.com/source/emea/f: Consider it done: How TAMM is transforming government services in Abu Dhabi with AI

name: AI for Everyone
description: South Korea is launching a government-backed initiative to provide all 52 million citizens with free access to a general-purpose AI chatbot and a proactive public-service AI agent as an essential public utility. The two-phase program targets housing, healthcare, education, employment and finance, with agents that autonomously complete multi-step tasks—such as finding housing and subsequently filing move-in reports, changing addresses and transferring utilities—without users navigating multiple apps; a public beta is planned for late September 2026 with full national rollout targeted before year-end.
novelty: It is the first G20 nation to treat AI as a public utility akin to broadband, establishing proactive agents as a nationwide service with a 'one-agent-per-citizen' target by 2027. Unlike general-purpose chatbots, these systems connect to actual public and private services (including Government24 and Zigbang) to execute end-to-end tasks autonomously, while mandates require operators to route at least 80% of queries through certified domestic foundation models to ensure sovereign AI infrastructure.
stakeholders: South Korean citizens (particularly older adults and low-income residents excluded from AI access), the Ministry of Science and ICT, three consortiums led by KT, SK Telecom and Kakao, domestic AI developers including Naver, LG AI Research and Upstage, and public-service entities across covered sectors.
agentic_rationale: The Phase 2 public-service AI agent autonomously manages tasks 'from planning via execution' without human initiation of each step, reading a citizen's circumstances to identify qualifying government benefits and complete applications on their behalf, and proactively handling multi-step workflows such as recalling a housing search to ask 'Have you filed your move-in report?' then automatically filing the report, changing postal addresses and transferring utilities.
tech_details: Operators must route at least 80% of queries through certified domestic models (50% via their own, 30% via other domestic firms) including KT's Mi:dm, Solar, Motif, LUXIA and VARCO on Rebellions NPUs, SK Telecom's A.X K2 and Kakao's Kanana and K-EXAONE, with foreign models permitted only in limited unsubsidized capacity. The government supplies 512 NVIDIA B200 GPUs to run the service, which integrates with Government24, PASS, Zigbang, EBS, Qanda and KakaoTalk and is accessible via apps, web, phone calls and text messages.

name: OSA Multi-Agent Assessment Workflow
organisation: Skills SA (Department of State Development, South Australia)
description: Skills SA has built a multi-agent AI workflow to review annual Organisational Self Assessment (OSA) submissions from vocational education and training providers against six student support standards. The system processes structured and unstructured data from hundreds of submissions to assess compliance, identify trends, and determine which providers require further investigation, reducing manual assessor effort while maintaining consistent standards application and complete audit trails.
novelty: The architecture uses a supervisor agent to orchestrate three specialized agents (operational, analysis, and decision support) that collaboratively assess complex compliance submissions, representing a reusable pattern for operational AI in regulated government environments with high-volume document processing requirements.
stakeholders: Skills SA assessors and operational staff, vocational education and training providers, and the South Australian Department of State Development.
agentic_rationale: A supervisor agent autonomously orchestrates three other agents to assess completed OSA forms, evaluate them against known standards, and determine whether further investigation or follow-up may be required, enabling the system to independently analyze submissions and flag those needing human judgment.
tech_details: The system runs largely on a Databricks stack and processes both structured data and large volumes of unstructured free text from compliance submissions using a multi-agent architecture with distinct supervisor, operational, analysis, and decision support agents.

source_titles.https://www.itnews.com.au/news/skills-sa: Skills SA to treat multi-agent workflow as a reusable pattern

name: State Department Agentic AI Malware Analysis Pilot
organisation: U.S. Department of State (Cyber Threat and Investigations division)
description: The State Department is piloting agentic AI to autonomously analyze malware found on thumb drives, reducing analysis time from four days to 25 minutes. The system operates in a sandbox environment where outputs are fact-checked against human work before integration into operational workflows.
novelty: One of the first reported federal deployments of agentic AI for cybersecurity operations, with explicit measurement of time savings and error rates against human benchmarks.
stakeholders: State Department cybersecurity analysts, malware experts in the Cyber Threat and Investigations division, and ultimately State Department mission personnel whose workload will be reduced.
agentic_rationale: The system can autonomously sort through malware on a thumb drive without human direction for each step, completing analysis in 25 minutes compared to four days manually. Romano describes training agents to do that analysis independently, with human fact-checking of outputs rather than step-by-step oversight.
tech_details: Sandbox environment for isolated testing; agentic AI architecture capable of complex task completion without human direction; integration planned with existing staff workflows pending validation of outputs.

source_titles.https://fedscoop.com/state-department-te: State Department is testing agentic AI to ‘buy back time’ for workers

name: DOS Generative AI Playbook
description: An official playbook offering practical guidance for U.S. government agencies on developing, scaling, and measuring enterprise GenAI solutions. It provides frameworks for agencies to implement advanced AI capabilities including multi-agent orchestration.
novelty: It represents one of the first comprehensive federal government playbooks explicitly addressing the orchestration of interconnected AI agents and providing structured guidance on advancing toward agentic AI capabilities across agencies.
stakeholders: U.S. federal government agencies, IT leaders, and AI implementation teams within the State Department and wider government.
agentic_rationale: The playbook specifically includes sections on 'orchestrating interconnected AI agents' and 'advancing toward agentic AI capabilities', addressing the coordination of multiple autonomous systems to execute tasks without requiring human initiation of each individual step.
tech_details: Focuses on enterprise GenAI solutions and agent orchestration frameworks; specific models or technical architectures are not detailed in the source.

source_titles.https://www.state.gov/wp-content/uploads: The Department of State Generative AI Playbook

name: DHS FOIA AI Processing Expansion
description: DHS is expanding AI use to address a backlog of over 245,000 pending Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests, leveraging machine learning to automate document review. The agency currently uses the RelativityOne platform within Customs and Border Protection to tag document responsiveness and plans to deploy new automation tools for redaction and relevance screening. A forthcoming contract with Deloitte for customized FOIA software featuring AI tools for audio masking, redactions, and field autopopulation is also planned.
novelty: The deployment marks a shift toward autonomous document classification, where the AI "learns" from human reviewers to "independently" make binary coding decisions on whether documents are responsive to requests—a capability that raises concerns about AI making legal determinations on transparency without human initiation of each decision. The expansion coincides with the loss of over 600 FOIA professionals government-wide, increasing reliance on automated decision-making.
stakeholders: DHS Office of Privacy, Customs and Border Protection FOIA division, FOIA requesters (public), departing government information specialists, and oversight advocates including the ACLU and EPIC.
agentic_rationale: The RelativityOne platform can "independently tag documents as relevant or not" after learning from reviewer decisions, enabling it to make binary coding decisions on document responsiveness without a human initiating each classification step. The system autonomously determines whether documents are responsive to FOIA requests based on learned patterns.
tech_details: RelativityOne document review and knowledge retrieval platform used for FOIA processing; planned Deloitte-customized FOIA software incorporating AI for audio masking, sensitive content redaction, document relevance scanning, field autopopulation, and public-facing chatbots.

source_titles.https://fedscoop.com/dhs-foia-processing: Homeland Security plans to add more AI to FOIA processing

name: Frontier AI Model Review Framework (Executive Order 14409)
organisation: U.S. Government (NSA, Department of Commerce, CISA)
description: Executive Order 14409 establishes a voluntary pre-release review framework for frontier AI models, requiring up to 30 days of government access before release for systems designated as 'covered frontier models' by the NSA. The NSA-run TRAINS program conducts classified benchmarking to identify models with advanced autonomous cyber capabilities, while OpenAI and Anthropic coordinate with the Trump administration to establish uniform cross-industry standards ahead of the August 1, 2026 deadline.
novelty: First U.S. federal framework to mandate pre-release government review of AI models based on classified NSA benchmarks for autonomous cyber exploitation capabilities, backed by Commerce Department authority to suspend global model access post-deployment under export control regulations.
stakeholders: Major AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, xAI, Microsoft), U.S. national security and commerce agencies, cloud infrastructure providers, the UK AI Safety Institute, and international Five Eyes intelligence partners.
agentic_rationale: The framework specifically targets models possessing 'advanced cyber capabilities — its ability to find and exploit software weaknesses autonomously' (per the classified NSA benchmark), regulating AI systems capable of independently identifying and weaponizing software vulnerabilities without human initiation of each exploitation step.
tech_details: The TRAINS program (Testing Risks of AI for National Security) operates under NIST's Center for AI Standards and Innovation, involving 10+ federal agencies and national laboratories using a classified capability threshold and a CVSS-modeled jailbreak severity scoring system developed collaboratively with participating labs.

source_titles.https://www.techtimes.com/articles/32191: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Writing the Threshold Their Rivals Must Clear for Launch

name: Federal Agentic AI Zero Trust Security
organisation: Defense Logistics Agency; 4th Marine Logistics Group
description: Federal agencies are deploying agentic AI across defense logistics and cybersecurity operations with a zero-trust security architecture that extends identity management to autonomous agents and machines. The initiative protects global logistics data from adversarial poisoning while implementing a "dynamic sliding scale" of autonomy—where 12-step processes shrink to single automated workflows with one human checkpoint—and leverages frontier models to scan 1.8 billion lines of code across 25 programming languages in eight weeks for vulnerability detection at machine speed.
novelty: The approach extends zero-trust principles to non-human agents through "agentic zero-trust" models that assign specific identities and enforce least-privilege policies on machine-driven actions, while pioneering a "dynamic sliding scale" of autonomy governed by rules of engagement rather than binary controls. It re-engineers military workflows around machine capabilities and enables autonomous cybersecurity analysis at unprecedented scale without human initiation of each scan.
stakeholders: Defense Logistics Agency, 4th Marine Logistics Group, US Department of Defense, Cisco, Accenture Federal Services, Okta, Anthropic, OpenAI, military commanders, warfighters, and federal agency security teams.
agentic_rationale: The system secures autonomous agents that execute "automated decisions" and workflow execution without human initiation for each step, condensing multi-step processes into automated workflows with minimal human checkpoints. Agents operate with "high autonomy with humans auditing outcomes after the fact" in low-risk contexts, present "fully verified courses of action" in high-risk settings, and independently analyze billions of lines of code to "scale detection and response at machine speed" while agencies govern "what tasks an agent is allowed to perform" through observability of machine-driven activity.
tech_details: Zero-trust architecture adapted for agentic AI using Okta for non-human identity management and defenses against adversarial data poisoning; employs frontier AI models from Anthropic (Project Glasswing) and OpenAI (Daybreak) to analyze 1.8 billion lines of code across 25 programming languages in eight weeks, wrapped in defense-grade security with domain-specific knowledge for edge-ready deployment across classified defense networks.

source_titles.https://breakingdefense.com/2026/08/if-s: If software and agentic AI are key to mission success, accelerate them to the front lines
